name: new-window
covers: File > New Window opens a second, fully loaded window that closes on the first click (Windows deadlock fixed in c4d9c5e). Ctrl+N goes through the same new_window command, but bad-ass-mcp can't send chords on macOS/Windows, so the menu path stands in for it. macOS is skipped: its menu bar belongs to the app, not the window, so window-scoped lookups can't reach it.

checks.manual: In the NEW window (list_windows, the one that isn't $WINDOW): find_elements name 'Insert emoji' returns ≥ 1 (it loaded, not blank white). Then click its close button (UIA name 'Close' on Windows; on Linux the window manager's close button, or xdotool windowclose if it isn't in the tree) once and check list_windows shows 1 MarkTheCrab window within 3 s.

notes: The toolbar also has a group named 'File' (the New/Open/Save buttons), so the menu needs its role. Roles marked confirm come from docs: fix them on first run.
